urls.rationale: Article 1 - Short Title and Definitions: defines terms (lobbyist, gift, official action) used across the Governmental Ethics Act lobbying-disclosure provisions.
Article 2 - Restricted Activities: limits and prohibitions on dealings with lobbyists and lobbying activity by public officials.
Article 3 - Code of Conduct: ethics rules including interactions with lobbyists.
Article 4A - Disclosure of Economic Interests: economic-interest disclosure regime for legislators and officials, parallel to lobbyist-side disclosure under 25 ILCS 170.

notes: Articles 3A (Governmental Appointees), 3B (Boards and Commissions), and 8 (Severability) intentionally excluded as not directly tied to lobbying-disclosure. Article 4A is the substantive disclosure provision; Articles 1-3 supply definitions and conduct framing.
